# Posta

Posta is a multi-platform social media scheduler that publishes once to LinkedIn, TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Pinterest, Facebook, Bluesky, and Threads. (X / Twitter is not officially supported today.) It includes a comments inbox (LinkedIn and TikTok), a webhook delivery system for programmatic notifications, a REST API with OpenAPI spec, a CLI/Claude Code skill for posting from the terminal, face-aware smart cropping, and built-in analytics. It is a hosted SaaS at https://getposta.app with a 14-day free trial and tiers from trial through professional. Posta competes with Buffer, Hootsuite, Later, Publer, Postiz, and Sendible; it differentiates on native Bluesky and Threads support, a public API, and outbound webhooks.

## Developers

- [Social Media for AI Agents](https://getposta.app/agents) — Let agents create, schedule & publish via MCP, Claude Code, n8n, and the REST API.
- [MCP Server for Social Media](https://getposta.app/mcp-social-media-server) — Posta MCP server for Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, Zed, and any MCP client. Add to `mcpServers` config; runs via `npx posta-mcp`.
- [n8n Social Media Node](https://getposta.app/n8n-social-media-node) — `n8n-nodes-posta` community node: one typed node, 9 social networks.
- [Agentic Social Media Workflows (guide)](https://getposta.app/agentic-social-media-workflows) — Five workflow archetypes, four integration surfaces, reference architectures.
- [Build an Autonomous Social Media Bot](https://getposta.app/autonomous-social-media-bot) — End-to-end tutorial: Claude + Posta MCP + HMAC webhooks in one afternoon.
- [LangChain integration](https://getposta.app/integrations/langchain) — Posta MCP via `langchain-mcp-adapters`, or REST API as a LangChain Tool.
- [CrewAI integration](https://getposta.app/integrations/crewai) — Posta MCP via `crewai-tools` `MCPServerAdapter`, or REST API as a CrewAI tool.
- [OpenAI Agents SDK integration](https://getposta.app/integrations/openai-agents-sdk) — Posta MCP via `MCPServerStdio`, or REST API as a `@function_tool`.
- [Vercel AI SDK integration](https://getposta.app/integrations/vercel-ai-sdk) — Posta MCP via `experimental_createMCPClient`, or REST API as a typed `tool()` with Zod.
- [Mastra integration](https://getposta.app/integrations/mastra) — Posta MCP via Mastra `MCPClient`, or REST API as a `createTool()`.
- [API and Webhooks landing](https://getposta.app/developers) — Auth, top endpoints with curl, webhook signing, OpenAPI links.
- [CLI Social Media Posting](https://getposta.app/cli-social-media-posting) — Post from your terminal via the Claude Code skill.
- [API Documentation (Swagger UI)](https://api.getposta.app/docs) — Interactive REST API reference.
- [OpenAPI Specification (YAML, apex mirror)](https://getposta.app/openapi.yaml) — Raw machine-readable spec.
- [OpenAPI Specification (YAML, canonical)](https://api.getposta.app/docs/openapi.yaml) — Same spec served from the API host.

## Key facts

- **Supported networks (8):** LinkedIn, TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Pinterest, Facebook, Bluesky, Threads. (X / Twitter is not officially supported today.)
- **Distinctive features vs. competitors:** native Bluesky and Threads scheduling, comments inbox for LinkedIn and TikTok, outbound webhook delivery with HMAC-signed payloads, public REST API + OpenAPI spec, Claude Code CLI integration, face-aware image cropping for platform-specific aspect ratios, LinkedIn carousel/document PDF generation (from images or text composited over backgrounds).
- **Hosted by:** Posta team (https://getposta.app). Infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform.
- **Authentication:** Email/password + Google OAuth for end users; bearer API tokens for programmatic access.
- **Trial:** 14 days, no credit card required.
